title: Chloroacetamide fragment library screening identifies new scaffolds for covalent inhibition of the TEAD.YAP1 interaction.
authors: Bum-Erdene, Khuchtumur; Ghozayel, Mona K; Zhang, Mark J; Gonzalez-Gutierrez, Giovanni; Meroueh, Samy O
one_liner_zh: 该文通过共价片段筛选和对接研究TEAD-YAP1蛋白-蛋白相互作用的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及转录因子TEAD，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且方法为共价对接而非AI或MD模拟，与课题关联度较低。
abstract: Transcriptional enhanced associate domain (TEAD) binding to co-activator yes-associated protein (YAP1) leads to a transcription factor of the Hippo pathway. TEADs are regulated by S-palmitoylation of a conserved cysteine located in a deep well-defined hydrophobic pocket outside the TEAD.YAP1 interaction interface. Previously, we reported the discovery of a small molecule based on the structure of flufenamic acid that binds to the palmitate pocket, forms a covalent bond with the conserved cysteine, and inhibits TEAD4 binding to YAP1. Here, we screen a fragment library of chloroacetamide electrophiles to identify new scaffolds that bind to the palmitate pocket of TEADs and disrupt their interaction with YAP1. Time- and concentration-dependent studies with wild-type and mutant TEAD1-4 provided insight into their reaction rates and binding constants and established the compounds as covalent inhibitors of TEAD binding to YAP1. Binding pose hypotheses were generated by covalent docking revealing that the fragments and compounds engage lower, middle, and upper sub-sites of the palmitate pocket. Our fragments and compounds provide new scaffolds and starting points for the design of derivatives with improved inhibition potency of TEAD palmitoylation and binding to YAP1.
abstract_zh: 转录增强关联域（TEAD）与共激活因子Yes相关蛋白（YAP1）的结合形成Hippo通路的一个转录因子。TEADs通过位于TEAD.YAP1相互作用界面外部深且明确的疏水口袋中的保守半胱氨酸的S-棕榈酰化进行调控。此前，我们报道了一种基于氟芬那酸结构的小分子的发现，该分子结合棕榈酸酯口袋，与保守半胱氨酸形成共价键，并抑制TEAD4与YAP1的结合。在此，我们筛选了一个氯乙酰胺亲电体的片段库，以识别与TEADs棕榈酸酯口袋结合并破坏其与YAP1相互作用的新骨架。对野生型和突变型TEAD1-4进行的时间和浓度依赖性研究提供了对其反应速率和结合常数的洞察，并确立了这些化合物作为TEAD与YAP1结合的共价抑制剂。通过共价对接生成了结合姿态假设，揭示片段和化合物与棕榈酸酯口袋的下部、中部和上部子位点结合。我们的片段和化合物为设计具有改善TEAD棕榈酰化和与YAP1结合抑制效力的衍生物提供了新骨架和起点。
